sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online, Melee)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 5 days since it was played. Magic Online: 67 tournaments, 752 lists from Challenges and other events, 196 from leagues; Melee: 4 tournaments, 50 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder.
